name: 9-handed cash, 100bb
description: Close approximation of widely published solver-informed full-ring charts for 100bb cash games. Facing-open and facing-3-bet ranges reuse the 6-max charts, mapping early seats onto UTG. Not solver output — edit anything in the Range Editor.

rfi.UTG: 66+, A9s+, A5s, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, AJo+, KQo
rfi.UTG+1: 55+, A8s+, A5s-A4s, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, T9s, AJo+, KQo
rfi.MP: 44+, A7s+, A5s-A3s, K9s+, Q9s+, J9s+, T9s, 98s, ATo+, KJo+
rfi.LJ: 33+, A2s+, K8s+, Q9s+, J9s+, T8s+, 98s, 87s, ATo+, KJo+, QJo
rfi.HJ: 22+, A2s+, K7s+, Q8s+, J8s+, T8s+, 97s+, 87s, 76s, ATo+, KTo+, QTo+, JTo

notes.groups: 9-handed seats map onto the 6-max groups: UTG and UTG+1 are EP; MP, LJ and HJ are MP. Limper, squeeze, limp-raise and 4-bet ranges are inherited from the 6-max chart.
